land_pattern.package: JST 'SMT type (viewed from component side)' / 'SM4 type / Side entry type' recommended PCB layout, page 1
land_pattern.notes: SMD part - NO DRILL. From the page-1 'SMT type (viewed from component side)' drawing, SM4 side entry view. All dimensions are referenced to the horizontal datum labelled 'End face of wafer on the mating side'. PRINTED VALUES: circuit pitch 2 +/-0.05 mm; solder-tab pad width 1.5 +/-0.1 mm; solder-tab pad length 3.4 +/-0.1 mm; 1.6 +/-0.1 mm from the inboard edge of each solder-tab pad to the centre of the adjacent end circuit; 0.2 mm from the wafer end face out to the outboard edge of the solder-tab pads; 5.5 max from the wafer end face to the near edge of the circuit pads; 9 min from the wafer end face to the far edge of the circuit pads; circuit pad width 1 min. DERIVED (arithmetic on the printed values, and confirmed by measuring the drawing's own vector rectangles against the 2.0 mm pitch: 4.854 pt/mm, every pad within 0.001 mm): circuit pad 1.0 x 3.5 mm (9 - 5.5 = 3.5); solder-tab pad 1.5 x 3.4 mm; circuit-pad row centre 7.25 mm from the wafer end face, solder-tab row centre 1.5 mm from it, hence row_spacing_mm 5.75 mm centre-to-centre; total land depth 9.2 mm; circuit span 2.0 x 9 = 18.0 mm (agrees with page-3 dim A for 10 circuits); solder-tab outer-edge to outer-edge 18.0 + 2 x (1.6 + 1.5) = 24.2 mm. pad_count 12 = 10 circuit pads + 2 solder-tab pads (both are copper, so fp_verify will count 12). pad_size_mm records the CIRCUIT pad only. Drawing note: 'Tolerances are non-cumulative: +/-0.05mm for all centers' and 'The dimensions above should serve as a guideline. Contact JST for details.'
